Definition: Peleth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name Peleth belongs to two men. One is a son of Jonathan, of the sons of Jerahmeel, and the other is the father of On, the Reubenite who joined Korah’s rebellion against Moses and Aaron.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name can stand on both sides of the line: one Peleth in the quiet genealogies, and another whose son rose against God's chosen leaders — and the difference is what each man did with his name.
